edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance authorizes the transferFrom.

msg.sender must equal pendingAdmin before admin rights are transferred.
msg.sender must equal admin before reserves can be reduced.
seizeInternal trusts msg.sender as the seizing cToken contract.
refreshCompSpeeds authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender to tx.origin.
_become verifies msg.sender is the Unitroller admin.
_setImplementation requires msg.sender == admin before swapping implementation.
_becomeImplementation requires msg.sender == admin before wiring Maker addresses.
Cheese.transferFrom derives the spender from msg.sender.
_setMiningBuff is gated by adminOrInitializing which inspects msg.sender.
tx.origin is used as the sole authorization predicate for speed refresh.
delegateBySig compares now (block.timestamp) against the supplied expiry.
Fallback forwards all calldata to the implementation through delegatecall.
delegateAndReturn delegatecalls implementation with the raw msg.data.
_setImplementation calls delegateToImplementation, reaching delegateTo.
delegateTo executes an arbitrary delegatecall to the supplied callee.
Unitroller fallback delegatecalls comptrollerImplementation with msg.data.

liquidateBorrowFresh makes an external seize call into another cToken.
CDaiDelegate.accrueInterest performs an external pot.drip() call.
doTransferOut calls into the Maker pot and DaiJoin before returning.
CEther forwards Ether using transfer(), which caps recipient gas.
delegateBySig recovers the signer with ecrecover before delegating.
Fallback uses inline assembly to copy and forward delegatecall returndata.
Checkpoint writes rely on 96-bit vote arithmetic and truncated block numbers.
accrueInterest relies on CarefulMath multiply/add/subtract results.
accrueInterest writes the newly computed borrowIndex.
accrueInterest writes the newly computed totalBorrows.
accrueInterest writes the newly computed totalReserves.
Accrual and exchange-rate math depend on totalSupply.
mintInternal first accrues interest before minting.
redeemFresh requires fresh interest accrual for the market.
borrowFresh requires fresh interest accrual for the market.
Liquidation accrues interest on both borrowed and collateral markets.
transferFrom delegates the accounting to transferTokens.
transferTokens updates accountTokens for source and destination.
transferTokens consumes the transferAllowances entry.
seizeInternal moves accountTokens from borrower to liquidator.
borrowFresh writes accountBorrows principal and interestIndex.
refreshCompSpeedsInternal recomputes emission speeds feeding compAccrued.
transferComp reads and clears the accrued cheese balance.
transferComp checks the Cheese balance held by the comptroller.

Liquidity computation reads collateral prices from the oracle.

redeemFresh decrements totalSupply with checked subtraction.
mintAmount is used to compute minted cTokens and transferred amount.
redeemTokensIn determines the underlying amount paid out.
borrowAmount is transferred out and added to borrow balances.
repayAmount drives the repay and seize sizing in liquidation.
seizeTokens adjusts borrower and liquidator accountTokens.
implementation_ becomes the delegatecall target in the delegator.
data is appended to an arbitrary delegatecall payload.
newPendingAdmin is stored as the next administrator.
holder determines whose accrued cheese is claimed.
user is the beneficiary of the external cheese transfer.
account drives the per-asset liquidity snapshot iteration.
cToken selects the market checked by the borrow policy hook.
MintLocalVars carries the mint and supply arithmetic results.
redeemAmount is derived from exchange-rate math before transfer out.
borrowIndexNew is persisted as the market borrow index.
oldImplementation records the previous delegatecall target.
signatory returned by ecrecover is delegated on behalf of.
pie is computed from pot.chi() and exited before payout.

normalization_plan.reason: mintAmount is a transient user parameter consumed directly by mintInternal.
redeemTokensIn only shapes the redeemFresh computation and leaves no state.
borrowAmount is a transient input resolved inside borrowFresh.
repayAmount is consumed only by liquidateBorrowFresh.
seizeTokens is a transient argument fully handled by seizeInternal.
implementation_ is folded into the _setImplementation delegatecall target.
data is only meaningful inside the delegateTo delegatecall.
newPendingAdmin is absorbed by _setPendingAdmin storage writes.
holder is only used to select accounts in claimComp loops.
user is only used as the recipient inside transferComp.
account is only iterated over in the liquidity computation.
cToken is only used for market lookups in borrowAllowed.
MintLocalVars exists purely as scratch space for mintInternal.
redeemAmount is a scratch value inside redeemFresh.
borrowIndexNew is a scratch value written by accrueInterest.
oldImplementation is a scratch value used for the upgrade event.
signatory is a scratch value derived in delegateBySig.
pie is a scratch value computed inside doTransferOut.
